newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart phases out hardware in some stores.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart phases out hardware in some stores.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc said on Monday that it will phase out its inventory of personal computer hardware from select stores and shift the merchandise to the remaining 1,600 stores where customer demand is the greatest.

In the 679 affected stores, the space previously used for the hardware will be used to expand the electronic categories that are more popular with customers at those specific stores, the company said. These stores will continue to offer computer software and accessories.
The company said the realignment begins immediately.
